caption:
Toto's calves feel like concrete after every run. Mileage jumps, hills, speed sessions or new shoes often show up in the calves first.

Remedial massage can help them feel looser and less sore for a while, but strength does the heavy lifting. Try slow single-leg calf raises, knee straight and knee bent, 3 sets to fatigue, two or three times a week. Keep firmer massage a day or two away from hard sessions or races.

Sudden sharp pain mid-run, swelling, bruising, or a red, warm calf should be checked promptly. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio work alongside our physios. Book online via the link in bio 🏃

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
